questions.text: number of Casa Grande jobs for Danny Ochoa asap

oracle.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM extractions t JOIN documents d ON d.id=t.document_id JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.document_id=d.id
JOIN entities c ON c.id=l.entity_id AND c.entity_type='customer'
WHERE t.field_key='technician' AND t.value='Danny Ochoa' AND c.data->>'service_address' ILIKE '%, Casa Grande,%'
